verdict.rationale: Pika documents a clip-extension feature that generates extra frames and continues a clip from its final frame, which covers the 'extend a clip' half of the story without re-rendering. It does not document regenerating a single time segment: the paint-and-edit and Swap Anything tools are spatial element edits, not segment regeneration. Missing for 10: documented regeneration of a chosen time segment within a clip, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extension quality.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video

citations.quote: Make any clip longer than its original by generating extra frames
Upload your clip and generate a continuation from its final frame to keep the scene and action moving.
